report_intro: 345 recovered component, composed-slice and explicit-input sequence cases: original numerical slices or mapped PE storage vs RustTran CLI. This is not a comparison of complete reactor simulations.
acceptance_description: Acceptance: integer/Boolean state exact; activation time exact as float32; exact binary32 IC restoration; up to 2 float32 ULP for accumulator, relief, PI, tank, outflow limits and startup; up to 2 ULP for normal thermal driving, reference initialization and pressure properties; up to 4 ULP for saturated/steam derivatives and isolated/composed loop-transfer outputs, with intermediate traces up to 2 ULP; primary phase/state/flow, heat-capacity and correction stages up to 2 ULP; connected primary core up to 4 ULP with exact phase/latch flags. Alternate decay heat keeps binary64 output and accepts absolute error <= max(1, |reference|) * 2e-13; float32 ULP is not applied to it.
inputs_description: Raw native units: psia, ft³, lb/s, Btu/lb and seconds. JSON contains full inputs and results. Steps are 0–1 s where supplied and event clocks are 0–300 s. These are component updates, not full trajectories. Decay-heat helper boundary probes additionally cover 10000/60000 seconds; original application runs are not extended past its cap.
limitations: Original x86 branches run in Unicorn. COM reads/writes are explicit state; setter callbacks, log formatting and UI cleanup are excluded where documented. Process-birth storage checks compare mapped PE bytes only, before application initialization.
Property callees use independently executed prefixes with modeled VB numeric helpers. Accumulator power is modeled with Python libm.

Alternate decay heat executes original VB6 Exp/Sqr; loop power executes the original VB6 DLL with a scratch errno cell and explicit x87 53-bit precision; the Windows app precision context has not been established.
Windows floating-point context, whole-plant dispatch and original error handling are not replayed.
Agreement in these cases is evidence for the translated blocks only; it does not validate complete PCTran scenarios.

reference_files.method:
Native thermal source0x51fc92–0x51fd6c and hydrogen0x52059e–0x520986.
All arithmetic/threshold/delay/latch/state branches execute original instructions.
Only log formatting0x5206e1–0x52086a is skipped; color setter HRESULT is modeled,
callbacks excluded. Original PowerR8 executes DLL code (CW0x027f); seven-point
wrapper executes and INTP uses independent native prefixes with explicit curves.
Upstream reaction state and curve loading remain supplied, not Windows scenarios.

Eight native-slice thermal/hydrogen + containment updates and two sixteen-update
chains. Current event4 flag/time overrides fallback controls; ignition time is
retained in the shared schedule. Explicit upstream reaction state/limit curve,
not original IC startup or a continuous Windows application scenario.
